Fußball-Club St. Pauli von 1910 e.V., commonly known as simply St. Pauli, is a German professional football club based in the St. Pauli district of Hamburg. The team will play in the 2. Bundesliga for the 2026–27 season following relegation from the Bundesliga in 2025–26.
